WHO WE ARE

Who is WOLNW? 

Word of Life Northwest Church has been commissioned by God to reach the world and to change lives through the preaching and teaching of God’s Word that transcends every cultural, racial, economical and denominational barrier; to nurture, buildup, encourage believers of all ages in the faith.
We are a life-changing ministry founded June 2016 on Biblical Principles and concepts that encourages, empowers, and develops people to live victorious lives and reach others for Christ. 

Who We Are

We are a life-changing ministry founded on Biblical Principles and concepts that encourages, empowers, and develops people to live victorious lives and reach others for Christ.

Philosophy of Ministry

We believe that Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever. He is still seeking and saving the lost, bringing all that will receive His love into eternal relationship with Him. You are not just joining a church but experiencing real life with others, which can only come from Jesus, the source of life. Our heart cry is to know Him and make Him known, not just to adhere to some church doctrine but also to really know Him and be changed by His word.
